result.summary: 本文介绍了 Llama 3 系列基础模型，包括 8B、70B 和 405B 三个参数规模的多语言语言模型，最大模型为密集 Transformer，支持最长 128K token 的上下文窗口 [S1.p3]。作者在约 15T 多语言 token 上预训练，旗舰模型使用 3.8×10^25 FLOPs，并采用 SFT、拒绝采样和 DPO 进行后训练 [S1.p5][S4.p1]。实验表明旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型质量相当，较小模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。作者还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3，并观察到这些方法在相应识别任务上具有竞争力，但这些多模态模型仍在开发中、尚未广泛发布 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 本文旨在提出并公开一套新的语言基础模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。作者希望公开旗舰模型的发布能推动研究社区创新，并加速负责任地迈向通用人工智能的发展 [S1.p7]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
The Llama 3 Herd of models natively supports multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.

We hope that the open release of a flagship model will spur a wave of innovation in the research community, and accelerate a responsible path towards the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).

method.text: Llama 3 采用标准密集 Transformer 架构，与 Llama 和 Llama 2 相比架构变化不大，性能提升主要来自数据质量与多样性以及训练规模 [S3.SS2.p1]。预训练使用约 15T 多语言 token，旗舰模型为 405B 参数、3.8×10^25 FLOPs [S1.p5]。后训练在预训练检查点上进行多轮对齐，每轮包含监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO），示例来自人工标注或合成生成 [S4.p1]。作者还通过组合式方法为 Llama 3 添加图像、视频和语音能力 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
our performance gains are primarily driven by improvements in data quality and diversity as well as by increased training scale.
We pre-train Llama 3 on a corpus of about 15T multilingual tokens, compared to 1.8T tokens for Llama 2.
our flagship language model was pre-trained using $3.8\times 10^{25}$ FLOPs
Each round of post-training involves supervised finetuning (SFT) followed by Direct Preference Optimization on examples collected either via human annotations or generated synthetically.
We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.

experiments.text: 作者对预训练模型、后训练模型以及安全性进行了广泛评估 [S5.p1]。预训练评估覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和综合评估等八类标准基准 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。后训练评估包括通用知识与指令遵循、编程、多语言、数学推理、长上下文和工具使用等基准 [S5.T16]。此外还进行了人类评估，将 Llama 3 405B 与 GPT-4、GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 进行比较 [S5.SS3.p4]。多模态方面，作者在图像识别、视频识别和语音理解任务上进行了实验 [S7.SS6.p1][S7.SS7.p3][S8.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: We performed an extensive series of evaluations of Llama 3, investigating the performance of: (1) the pre-trained language model, (2) the post-trained language model, and (3) the safety characteristics of Llama 3.

These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
Table 16: Post-training benchmarks by category. Overview of all benchmarks we use to evaluate post-trained Llama 3 models, ordered by capability.
We use our human evaluation process to compare Llama 3 405B with GPT-4 (0125 API version), GPT-4o (API version), and Claude 3.5 Sonnet (API version).

We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning
We present the performance of Llama 3 8B and 70B in Table 30.
We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.

findings.text: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，较小模型在同参数规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。Llama 3 8B 在几乎所有类别上优于竞争模型，70B 在多数基准上大幅优于 Llama 2 70B，并优于 Mixtral 8x22B [S5.SS1.SSS1.p4]。人类评估中，Llama 3 405B 与 GPT-4 0125 版本大致相当，与 GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 相比互有胜负 [S5.SS3.p4]。多模态方面，Llama 3-V 405B 在所有图像识别基准上优于 GPT-4V，但略落后于 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet [S7.SS6.p2]；语音接口在语音识别基准上优于 Whisper 和 SeamlessM4T [S8.SS4.p3]。

evidence.quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
The results show that Llama 3 8B outperforms competing models in virtually every category, both in terms of per-category win rate and in terms of average per-category performance.
We also find that Llama 3 70B outperforms its predecessor Llama 2 70B by a large margin on most benchmarks
Llama 3 70B also outperforms Mixtral 8x22B.
We observe that Llama 3 405B performs approximately on par with the 0125 API version of GPT-4, while achieving mixed results (some wins and some losses) compared to GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
Using the resulting Llama 3-V 405B model, we outperform GPT-4V on all benchmarks, while being slightly behind Gemini 1.5 Pro and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
our model outperforms models that are tailored to speech like Whisper and SeamlessM4T on all benchmarks.

limitations.text: 作者指出，多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S1.p8]。安全性方面，作者承认没有任何测试能保证穷尽所有风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其是在英语之外的语言以及被熟练对抗性红队人员提示工程时 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。人类评估方面，由于难以定义客观标准，评估仍可能受标注者个人偏见、背景和偏好的影响，导致结果不一致或不可靠 [S5.SS3.p5]。此外，安全基准是 Meta 内部的，作者承认这些数字无法在外部复现 [S5.SS4.SSS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: These models are still under active development and not yet ready for release.
However, no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk.
Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
human evaluations can still be influenced by personal biases, backgrounds, and preferences of human annotators, which may lead to inconsistent or unreliable results.
we acknowledge that the numbers in this section are not reproducible externally
